svg.title: Figure 5 · SysML packages and imports
svg.desc: The five project packages and the documentation views that import them, read from every .sysml file the OMG pilot validates. No view redefines a system part or requirement.
svg.text: The five project packages and the documentation views that import them, read from every .sysml file the OMG pilot validates. No view redefines a system part or requirement.

Generated by tools/figures/models_readme.py from the .sysml files, tools/sysml/check.py and the records. The records are the source of truth; the model is checked against them. Passing a check is not a review.

g.text: Terms: CI = continuous integration (the automated checks GitHub runs on every change) · OMG = Object Management Group, publisher of SysML · PX4 = PX4 Autopilot, the open-source flight-control software candidate for SUS-A1 · SUS-A1 = dockable
observation UAV · SysML = Systems Modeling Language (SysML v2) · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone)
